{{Quote|Like the native Shi'ido, this slider can be just about anything. You name the ingredients, and we'll put it together for you.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Lao-mon slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Lao-mon sliders''' were one of the speciality [[slider]]s on the menu at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The slider was named<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> after the planet [[Lao-mon]]<ref name="Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and inspired by the [[Shi'ido]], the worlds [[Homeworld/Legends|native]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> [[Species/Legends|species]], and their ability to [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshift]].<ref name="Guide to Alien Species" /> The diner allowed customers to name the ingredients they wanted on their slider and the staff would make it for them. It cost 7.7 [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lao-mon sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
